snippet.title: SMS Returns - 7th Street Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4670920/SMS_Returns/
Join the official Discord:  https://discord.gg/7fSvvdaqgm

Stranded on a fog-shrouded abandoned city street, explore empty sidewalks, alleyways, and derelict buildings under dim lights. This isolating urban ghost town offers scant shelter as a tall entity stalks relentlessly from the surrounding darkness.
